brows_intro_de: In physiognomy, eyebrows are seen as a person's “running ticker”: they reveal your trajectory of communication and how you tackle tasks—and often reflect what is happening with your siblings as well.

photo_errors_de.no_face: I couldn't detect a face. Please send a frontal selfie in good lighting with hair away from your forehead.
photo_errors_de.multiple_faces: There are multiple faces in the photo. Please send a selfie showing only you.
photo_errors_de.too_small: Your face is too small in the frame. Please move closer to the camera so your face fills the image well.
photo_errors_de.turned: Your head is turned too much. Please look straight into the camera (frontal).
photo_errors_de.dark: The photo is too dark or blurry. Please find good daylight and send a new selfie.
photo_errors_de.brows_hidden: Your eyebrows aren't clearly visible. Please move hair away from your forehead and send a new selfie.
photo_errors_de.low_confidence_brow: On this photo, the primary shape of your eyebrows could not be determined with sufficient certainty (borderline angle, shadow, or unclear contour). Please take a new front-facing selfie in even daylight — or select your eyebrow shape manually using the visual guide below.

disclaimer_de: Note: This reading is intended for entertainment and self-reflection. It is not medical, psychological, or legal advice, nor is it a prediction of fate. If a mole changes (in size, color, shape, itching, or bleeding), please consult a dermatologist.

dicht.short_de: The denser your eyebrows, the more strongly you seek interaction and connection with others. What you start, you usually carry forward steadily.

dichte_wechselt.short_de: Dense near the bridge of the nose, sparser from the middle onward: you launch projects with great clarity and power, but later need fresh motivation to stay the course.

duenn.short_de: The finer your eyebrows, the more selective you are. You don't grant trust immediately—not out of harshness, but out of caution.

duenn_unruhig.short_de: Fine, uneven brows point to a sensitive, shifting mood. You are selective and sometimes react impulsively.

breiter_zum_ende.name_de: Eyebrows widening toward the outer end
breiter_zum_ende.short_de: You take a little time to warm up to new situations—yet the further you go, the more stable and dependable you become.

tief.name_de: Low-set eyebrows close to the eye
tief.short_de: Low-set brows reveal a realist: you look closely at the core of things and prefer to prepare for difficult scenarios in advance.

hoch_winkel.short_de: High-set eyebrows indicate openness to the world: impressions enter freely and you seek to shape your surroundings visibly (source M12:295–312).

hoch_winkel_scharf.name_de: High-set eyebrows with a distinct angle
hoch_winkel_scharf.short_de: High eyebrows with a pronounced angle point to openness, strong self-confidence, and a fiery temperament (source M12:295–312).

hoch_winkel_sanft.short_de: High, smoothly rounded eyebrows without a sharp break reflect gentle openness, receptivity, and optimism (source M12:295–312).

mark30.free_found_de: Optical observation on this photo (sources M12:316–331, L01:689–695): In the middle section of your eyebrow, a gap or lighter density is visible. In traditional teaching, this is a conditional indicator of a potential milestone around ages 27–30 — however, it is not a deterministic prediction and always requires cross-checking with the lines of the hands and overall facial features.
mark30.free_not_found_de: Optical observation on this photo (source M12:316–318): In the middle section of your eyebrow (corresponding to roughly ages 27–30), the hair contour appears even on this image without a visible break. This describes only the optical appearance on the photo and does not promise an event-free or automatically smooth period.
mark30.free_unknown_de: Optical note for this photo: The middle zone of the eyebrow (ages 27–30 section per M12:316–318) could not be evaluated with sufficient optical certainty on this image due to lighting, contrast, or hair near the forehead. No individual conclusion is drawn for the 30-year mark.
